title: Bitsocial Seeder Compatibility Communities
description:
Public Bitsocial communities that default bitsocial-seeder operators should seed even when they are not part of a client directory list. This file lives in 5chan-directories for compatibility with existing bitsocial-seeder releases, which poll every JSON file in this folder except defaults files. It is not a 5chan directory file.

https://github.com/bitsocialnet/lists/blob/master/5chan-directories/bitsocial-seeder-communities.json
